# netcup_clouddns_domain (Data Source)

One domain of the netcup API key, looked up by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_clouddns_domain" "example" {
  fqdn = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fqdn` (String) Domain name, e.g. `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Id of the domain.
- `is_dns_managed` (Boolean) The `isDnsManaged` value of the netcup API.
